POPIA Information

Privacy and data-handling topics for South African users.

DRAFT — requires professional legal review.

Not attorney-approved. Final wording and organisation details must be approved before broad public launch.

Purpose of this page

This draft explains the privacy topics O-IBS must finalise before launch. It does not assert POPIA compliance or replace the reviewed privacy notice. The responsible party and Information Officer details remain subject to confirmation.

Clear purposes and limited information

The final documentation should explain what personal information is needed, why it is processed and how unnecessary collection is avoided. Information entered into the current website form is not submitted or stored.

Business information and authorised access

Customer and supplier records can contain personal information. Final policies must clarify the roles of O-IBS and its business users, authorised access and appropriate operator arrangements. This public site has no access to application company records.

Responsible assistance

Website Bizzy examples are fictional. The application’s AI data flows, providers, safeguards and retention need documented review. Human review remains important for uncertain information and actions that change business records.

Access, correction and other requests

An approved privacy contact and request procedure are still required. The final process should explain identity verification and how access, correction, deletion or objections are handled where applicable.

Questions and complaints

The Information Regulator provides official South African privacy information and a complaints process. O-IBS contact details must be approved before this draft becomes public release wording.

Approved contact details

An operational O-IBS privacy address has not been configured. Approved contact details and a request process will be added before release.

Official resources: Information Regulator — POPIA · Complaints information
